name: 试模（问题/分析/对策）流程

map.试模问题统计与整改优先级: Trial-mold problem statistics and rectification priority
map.填写试模次数，逐行输入「问题,次数,严重度」（严重度 1 轻微、2 一般、3 严: Enter the trial-mold count and input each line as 'Problem, Count, Severity' (Severity: 1 minor, 2 moderate, 3 severe). Problem density = total problems / trial-mold count; weighted problem index = sum(count x severity), used to set the rectification priority.
map.问题数据（每行「问题,次数,严重度」）: Problem data (one line per 'Problem, Count, Severity')
map.📚 深度解析：试模问题统计与整改优先级: 📚 In-depth: Trial-Mold Problem Statistics and Rectification Priority
map.模具试模阶段记录飞边、欠铸、粘模、气孔等问题次数与严重度，确定整改先后顺序。: Record the frequency and severity of flash, short shot, sticking, blowholes and other defects during the trial-mold stage to set the order of rectification.
map.新模具验收时用问题密度衡量单次试模的平均问题数，判断是否达到量产条件。: At new-mold acceptance, use problem density to gauge the average number of problems per trial mold and decide whether mass-production conditions are met.
map.工艺改进后复测试模，对比加权问题指数验证改进效果。: Re-run trial molding after process improvement and compare the weighted problem index to verify the improvement.
map.试模次数 12，输入「飞边,8,2；欠铸,5,3；粘模,3,2；气孔,6,1」，: Trial-mold count 12, input 'Flash,8,2; Short shot,5,3; Sticking,3,2; Blowhole,6,1': total problems 22, problem density 1.83, weighted problem index 43; both the most frequent and highest-weighted defect is flash (16).
map.建议三档：1 轻微（可后处理修复）、2 一般（需调模或修模）、3 严重（影响尺寸: Three suggested levels: 1 minor (fixable by post-processing), 2 moderate (needs mold adjustment or repair), 3 severe (affects dimensions or performance, must be reworked).
It depends on product complexity; the tool gives a three-tier hint from the weighted index divided by trial-mold count: >=3 needs systematic rectification, 1.5-3 needs focused improvement, <1.5 means few problems.
map.不够，少数严重问题的影响可能远超大量轻微问题，加权指数把严重度折算进来，排序更贴: Yes. A few severe problems can outweigh many minor ones; the weighted index factors in severity, ranking closer to actual rectification priority.
